truth_yaml_said.x-notes: Bare array. page-size respected. This is the correct listing path. GET /workspaces/{workspaceId}/time-entries (no userId) returns 405.
truth_yaml_said.patch_notes: PATCH /user/{userId}/time-entries (NO /stop suffix) used by clockify_entries_timer_stop to stop a running timer — sends {end: RFC3339}.
truth_yaml_said.get_response_schema: bare array (same shape as single GET)

live_probe_result.notes_on_page_size: Attempted page-size=1000000 in a parallel probe — upstream rejected with 'Page size cannot be larger than 5,000', confirming an undocumented server-side cap at 5000. TRUTH.yaml documents max 200 for this param.

secondary_finding.finding: TRUTH.yaml documents page-size maximum as 200, but the server accepts up to 5000. The 200 cap is enforced by the MCP typed tool layer (clockify_entries_list), not Clockify itself. TRUTH.yaml maximum bound is conservative relative to the live server — not a demotion, but a precision gap.

notes: Devil re-probe via GET with far-future date window (2099): returned bare empty array [] with HTTP 200 — confirms GET path is live and bare-array shape holds for empty result sets. TRUTH.yaml documents 200 with bare array schema, confirmed correct. Secondary finding: page-size server cap is 5000, not 200 — the 200 limit is a tool-layer constraint, not a Clockify API constraint. TRUTH.yaml should note this distinction.
